_: A 20-case sample of the authored half of the Monitoring record: cases written family by family, each with its declared nature and one-sentence reason. No real transaction and no real person. This is the only labelled data of the set left public; the full set (84 rows) is private. Rule, fixed and not hand-picked: rank rows by SHA-256 of the string `crusetra-monitoring-jeux-2026-10-19:<id>`. Step 1 keeps the lowest-ranked row of each of the 12 nature values (cash-intensive, dormant-burst, layering-fan-out, loan-repayment, one-off-purchase, payroll, rapid-movement, rent-collection, round-tripping, savings-transfer, seasonal-trade, structuring). Step 2 adds the lowest-ranked remaining rows until there are 20. Rows are then sorted by id.
